title: Ginny Doll - Easter Bunny Vintage 1984 Vogue Dolls Poseable Vinyl 8"
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The Ginny Doll Easter Bunny Vintage 1984 by Vogue is a fashion doll made of vinyl. The doll, measuring 8 inches in width, is part of a set that includes the doll itself. It features the character Ginny Doll and is designed for the occasion of Easter.
